title: Baker Mayfield: Loss stings because we're 0-2, not because it was to Browns

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Baker Mayfield: Loss stings because we're 0-2, not because it was to Browns
sources.description: After the schedule for the 2026 season was released in the spring, Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield said he had the team's Week 2 game against the Browns circled.
